ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=6302e2c10e48 (2026-05-05T10:28:04Z) modified currency-service's precision_utils.go and convert.go, replacing the shopspring/decimal arbitrary-precision library with native float64 arithmetic for exchange rate calculations. This introduced IEEE 754 floating-point epsilon drift in multiply/divide chains (e.g., 100.00 USD → 88.99999999999997 EUR instead of 89.00), causing virtually all conversion results to fail the checkout-service's strict rounding threshold validation (±0.001), and payment-service to reject serialization of non-normalized float values to its payment gateway schema.
ground_truth_remediation: Immediately roll back currency-service to sha=5acdff618e47 using `kubectl rollout undo deployment/currency-service` or by redeploying the previous image tag. This restores the shopspring/decimal library and correct exchange rate precision. Re-open the circuit breaker on checkout-service once currency-service health checks pass. After service restoration, re-queue any failed orders from ord-44821 through ord-44851 and audit for any payment holds placed during the incident window.
